name: BrowserStack MCP
description: Run manual and automated tests on real devices and browsers, scan for accessibility issues and manage test cases from AI agents via BrowserStack's MCP server, for QA teams.

skills.name: Manual Testing
skills.description: Opens mobile apps and websites on BrowserStack's real devices and browsers for manual testing, including sites on localhost.

skills.name: Automated Tests
skills.description: Runs Playwright, Selenium, Jest and other automated test suites on BrowserStack and helps debug and fix failures.

skills.name: Accessibility Scans
skills.description: Scans local or production websites for accessibility issues and suggests fixes for WCAG and ADA compliance.

skills.name: Test Management
skills.description: Creates projects, folders, test cases and test runs in BrowserStack Test Management and updates test results.

skills.name: Load Testing
skills.description: Finds and runs load tests, reads results and AI Insights, compares two runs and checks VU-hour quota before a big run.
